name: Hevo Business Central Connector
brief: Read-only API pages that expose Business Central data to Hevo's Business Central connector, and a feed of deleted records.
description: Read-only API pages (route hevo/businessCentral/v1.0) for the 48 company-scoped objects Hevo's Business Central connector syncs, plus delete capture: each delete of a row those pages read is recorded in a per-company tombstone table, read through the deletedRecords and integrationStatus pages, and kept under a retention policy.
